name: cli-engine-english-translation-execution
title: Execute the cli-engine English translation plan (Phases 0-4, excluding behavior-sensitive rows)
description: Implement docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md. Phase 0: add scripts/extract-cli-engine-english-manifest.mjs and regenerate/freeze the line-level manifest against the CURRENT packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts (now 767 Chinese lines vs the doc's 762-row snapshot), re-anchoring sourceLine and adding the 5 new rows, then mark rows approved. Phase 1: translate the public CLI surface in cli-engine.ts (command descriptions, Zod .describe() values, printHelp labels/examples, validation error text, unknown-command suggestions, story/worktree next-step hints) to English per the approved manifest, updating tests that assert old Chinese output. Phase 2: translate internal comments in cli-engine.ts (preserve technical meaning, no logic changes). Phase 3: add a no-new-Chinese gate smoke test (english-open-source-surface-smoke) that fails on new Chinese in active source/docs, with allowlists for this review doc, generated manifests, legacy archives, and migration compatibility tests. Phase 4: translate related active docs (README.md, docs/guide.md, docs/guide-hooks.md, active docs/requirements/decisions/) and move historical Chinese material to explicit legacy/archive locations. The 3 behavior-sensitive rows (M668/M669/M750 — regex/.includes matchers over Chinese) are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and deferred to a dedicated follow-up story with coordinated code+test changes.
